discription: A gentle pulse wave pad with a slow attack and release, and a subtle LFO on the pulse width for a nuanced texture.
code: { arg out=0, freq=220, amp=0.1, gate=1, pan=0, pulseWidth=0.5, lfoFreq=0.5, lfoDepth=0.1; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(2.0, 0.5, 0.7, 3.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); var pwMod = SinOsc.kr(lfoFreq, 0, lfoDepth, pulseWidth); sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pwMod) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan, amp)); }
